facts.statement: A 5% community-pool tax comes off staking rewards before validators and delegators split what is left.
PSE (x/pse, Proof of Support Emission) distributes to stakers monthly by score, with no validator commission.
facts.source: tx-chain v7.0.0 x/pse/spec/README.md (score-based monthly distribution) and x/pse/keeper/distribute.go:228,390,424 (amount = total x score / total score, sent to the delegator and auto-delegated; no commission term)

facts.statement: A validator's minimum commission rate is 5%.
PSE is roughly 10.8x the inflation staking pool right now.
Slashing is 5% for double-signing and 0.01% for downtime.
Proposal 47 (v8 upgrade, voting until 2026-10-14) may change inflation and PSE timing.
